subject.title: docs: document replay history normalization contract

question: Should maintainers recreate the two compaction retry timeout comments on current main now, or wait for the contributor to refresh this conflicting stacked branch?
rationale: The branch is protected by the maintainer label, conflicting, and not maintainer-editable, while the latest discussion narrows the useful work to a tiny docs-only slice that should be adapted to current main.

options.title: Recreate focused docs slice
options.body: Apply only the two timeout-contract comments to current main with current helper names, run git diff --check, and avoid merging this stacked branch wholesale.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the contributor to rebase and reduce it to the current-main comment slice.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: Once a focused replacement is merged, close this stale source PR with a link to the replacement commit or PR.
